fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) fell 10.8% on November 5 as midterm election results triggered deteriorating outlooks for data centers and acquisitions.
fields.summary_ko.1: Operating margin collapsed from 6.6% to 2.6% in Q3, and anticipated ~$20 billion capital expenditure in 2026 is intensifying cost pressures and profitability headwinds.
